Reviewed the incremental node-pty native-backend integration in d2b6657 against this document and changed inputs: docs/architecture/module-map.md. Traced the published 1.2.0-beta.18 native mutex repair, managed Windows close/kill patch, positive-PID startup admission, paused reads until a first subscriber, late exit replay, and invalid-directory rejection through NodePtyAdapter and its real Windows tests. Cleanup deadline remains six seconds. The hosted worker exit has no native dump and is not claimed reproduced or conclusively attributed to the upstream race. Mac retention is not green; the pre-upgrade control also refuses immediate close at the controlling-TTY fence, tracked in #4635.
